messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Jordan from Stellara just replied: procurement is insisting on an "approval stub" (one-page signoff) before Finance will route the PO. DocuSign link we sent shows the wrong billing entity so they won't sign it. Can we unblock?
Liam (AM): Ugh. Which billing entity is on the envelope?
Maya (CS): It shows parent org (Stellara Group) but they need Subsidiary: Stellara BioSciences, EIN ending 449.
Jordan (Customer Finance): Confirmed — our AP will only sign if the stub lists Stellara BioSciences + vendor code. DocuSign is flagged as Group and the PO won't match.
Priya (Ops): @Maya can you paste the DocuSign envelope ID? We can check redirect mapping.
Maya (CS): envelopeId: 0a9f8d2b-33f4-4b2f-a1c9 
Maya (CS): Customer also wants an emailed PDF they can attach to internal approval flow (they hate clicking external links).
Ethan (Legal): Two angles: 1) Quick fix: generate a separate one-page approval stub with sign block that references the main SOW and has the correct billing entity. 2) Long term: we need the correct legal entity on the primary envelope. Which is faster?
Liam (AM): Quick fix preferred — Jordan needs something by EOD to keep the renewal on target this week.
Priya (Ops): I can generate a stub PDF template. Need the exact vendor code and wording they require. Any sample from customer?
Jordan (Customer Finance): Vendor code: VB-3389. Wording: "Approval: Stellara BioSciences (EIN: xxx-xx-449) — This approval references the Redwood Inference Order Form dated 2026-02-11 and authorizes procurement to issue PO number XYZ."
Maya (CS): Copying their exact email thread into the stub now.
DocuSign Bot: Notice — envelope 0a9f8d2b-33f4-4b2f-a1c9 shows signer mismatch warning.
Ethan (Legal): Two small legal asks for the stub: include a line "This stub is not an amendment to the Agreement" and a signature block with name/title/email. That'll keep us covered.
Priya (Ops): Working on PDF. I'll prefill name/title fields as empty lines so they can complete it in AP.
Liam (AM): If they still refuse to use DocuSign, are we okay accepting a scanned wet signature for this customer?
Ethan (Legal): For renewals under $250k we can accept wet-signed attachments as exception but Ops must confirm chain-of-custody (upload to Box + audit note). If >$250k we need exec sign-off. This renewal is 120k so wet is acceptable.
Maya (CS): Great — I'll propose three options to Jordan: (A) Sign stub via DocuSign (fastest if entity changed), (B) Receive prefilled PDF stub they attach to PO, (C) Wet-signed PDF they scan and return. Which do you want?
Jordan (Customer Finance): Option B is easiest for AP internal flow. Please include vendor code and a contact email for verification (ap@stellara.bio).
Priya (Ops): Draft done. Attaching a DocSend link: https://docsend.com/view/redwood-stub-1772469999 (contains form fields).
Maya (CS): Sent to Jordan. Also added an internal audit note: "stub created per procurement request; saves original envelope id 0a9f8d2b for trace."
Liam (AM): Thx — call scheduled with Jordan at 4pm to confirm. I can join if anything escalates.
Ethan (Legal): We'll also update the primary envelope entity mapping after this closes so future renewals show correct subsidiary. Priya, can you put a follow-up ticket for that?
Priya (Ops): Yep — created ticket OPS-7842 to fix entity mapping and audit who last modified billing metadata.
Jordan (Customer Finance): Received DocSend link, placing stub into our AP workflow now. Will update once PO issued. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Marking thread resolved for now. If Jordan reports PO mismatch again, we'll escalate to billing ops and legal.
Liam (AM): Appreciate the quick turn.
Maya (CS): Closing when PO lands.
